claims.text: The SGD 6.00 in EV-FARE-00202 (total_charged 6.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) can be charged to the rider only if all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold at once: a driver 'arrived' event in the trip record; a position inside the pickup geofence on the POL-NS-02 test at or before that event; a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 480 s for this AIRPORT pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and NOT from the arrived tap; and a driver-terminated trip on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT at or after the dwell elapsed. The rider puts the driver's side to proof on each limb separately, on the code-computed facts rather than on either party's narrative, because the fee is not chargeable if any one limb fails.

Limb (b) is satisfied on the derived facts and the rider does not contest it: EV-GPS-00202 reports 63 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a closest approach of 22.4 m to the pickup pin, well inside the 150 m arrival radius set for the AIRPORT zone, and the first qualifying fix at 23:12:45 precedes the 23:13:10 arrived event in EV-TRIP-00202, so proximity is not in issue. The same 22.4 m closest approach also closes the POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance route, which requires the driver to have been stationary OUTSIDE the POL-NS-02 radius but within 400 m. The trace is unimpaired on its face (116 fixes, 10 s cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0 s), so nothing under POL-NS-08(a) or (b) can be argued against it either, and the rider does not try.

The dwell limb is satisfied and is not honestly contestable: the code computes a single continuous in-geofence run of 620 s (23:12:45 to 23:23:05) against the 480 s AIRPORT minimum, with shortfall_sec of -140 s, i.e. 140 seconds of surplus, and the cancellation at 23:23:20 falls after the minimum elapsed at 23:20:45. POL-NS-06 therefore has nothing to bite on — there is no waiting-period shortfall, and its full refund is unavailable — and the rider does not put a shortfall case, because on these numbers a shortfall claim would be an invention.

POL-NS-04 is closed at its own threshold and the rider does not press it: limb (a) requires at least one locating or coordinating message sent BY THE RIDER during the waiting window, and EV-CHAT-00202 holds three messages — a SYSTEM 'Your driver has arrived' notice at 23:13:11 and two driver messages at 23:14:02 and 23:19:30 — with no rider message at all and read_at null on all three. The rider's account that he did not see the messages until later is consistent with those unread timestamps, but an unread inbound message is not a rider message and cannot satisfy limb (a); limbs (a) and (b) therefore fail before limb (c) is ever reached.

POL-NS-05 is equally closed: it fires only where the arrived marker catches the driver more than 300 m from the pickup pin or travelling at 15 km/h or more, and the derived arrival places the driver's first qualifying in-geofence fix 25 seconds BEFORE the 23:13:10 marker, at a closest approach of 22.4 m. There is no false-arrival point on this record and the rider does not allege one.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road: EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING, has no payload and carries weight 0.0 under POL-GEN-02, so POL-NS-06(i) can be invoked by nobody to accumulate or excuse in-geofence time, and the derived arrival confirms limb (i) is unavailable because the trace shows a single in-geofence interval held in position. The rider asks only that the single 620 s run be the whole of the dwell arithmetic, and accepts that the missing artifact carries no fact in the rider's favour either.

The profile files may be used only as POL-GEN-01 permits. On the rider's file, prior_no_show_flags (1) is a lifetime counter and is NOT rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d (also 1), which only POL-NS-09(d) reads, and only at 3 or more; nor may prior_disputes_filed (3), prior_disputes_upheld (1), rating (4.9) or lifetime_trips (1174) ground any finding against him. On the driver's file only no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d are citable, and only for the POL-NS-07 anti-farming test — his rating and acceptance_rate are context only.

The rider's whereabouts are not an element of the charge, and the rider asks that they not be used as a makeweight in either direction: POL-NS-01 contains no rider-presence limb, and POL-NS-06 fixes the fee against the driver's dwell 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. The rider track in EV-GPS-00202 (88 fixes, stationary throughout, device 2.0-2.2 km from the pin, 0 qualifying fixes inside the 200 m presence radius) and the rider's account of a delayed flight therefore neither ground the charge nor defeat it; the only rider-side route in which rider position matters is POL-NS-04(c), which is not reached because no rider message exists.

claims.text: The trip record contains a driver 'arrived' event for TRP-00202 at 2026-07-24T23:13:10 (time_to_arrival 8.9 min after acceptance), so limb (a) of the baseline chargeable no-show is met.

The GPS trace places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius from 23:12:45, twenty-five seconds before the 'arrived' marker, with 63 qualifying in-radius fixes and a closest approach of about 22 m; limbs (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are therefore satisfied on admissible fixes, and the zone class comes from trip_record (AIRPORT), not from assumption.

The driver held position inside the geofence in a single continuous qualifying run of 620 seconds, from 23:12:45 to 23:23:05 — 140 seconds more than the 480-second minimum dwell for the AIRPORT zone class — so limb (c) is met and there is no waiting-period shortfall.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 23:23:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the 620-second dwell had elapsed and with no boarding event anywhere in the record, satisfying limb (d).

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at the 23:13:10 marker the driver was already stationary inside the geofence (in position since 23:12:45), roughly 22 m from the pin — neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or above — so the false-arrival route does not displace the fee.

POL-NS-03 is not in play: that clause governs a driver stationary OUTSIDE the arrival radius but within 400 m, whereas the driver's 63 qualifying fixes here fall inside the 150 m AIRPORT radius, so the wrong-entrance refund route does not apply and fault allocation under it is unnecessary.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. Limb (a) fails outright: the chat log holds no rider message at all during the waiting window — its three entries are the SYSTEM arrival notice and two driver messages. Limb (c) also fails affirmatively: the rider track records zero qualifying fixes inside the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius, the rider's device sitting roughly 2.0 to 2.2 km from the pin for the whole window.

The chat log corroborates the driver's account rather than the rider's: at 23:14:02 he posted his location and plate number ('door 5 T3 arrival, black Toyota Altis SLA1234X') and at 23:19:30 he followed up ('still waiting ah'). Both messages were delivered but never read (read_at null), and no rider reply or in-app voice call appears in trip_record.in_app_calls anywhere before termination.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, the driver is owed 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee, i.e. SGD 4.80. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 of 168 completed trips in 30 days is far below the 0.08 rate, so no limb of that guard is met.

The SGD 6.00 charged reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule: the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) is SGD 6.00, exactly the fare_breakdown cancellation-fee line, so there is no fare defect that would impair the fee under POL-NS-08(d).

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 6.00 no-show fee on trip TRP-00202 stands, and the driver is owed SGD 4.80. Here is how I got there.

THE FEE IS CHARGEABLE UNDER POL-NS-01. All four limbs hold on the code-computed facts, and the rider's own advocate conceded each of them rather than pretending otherwise:
(a) EV-TRIP-00202 records the driver's 'arrived' event at 2026-07-24T23:13:10.
(b) EV-GPS-00202 places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius from 23:12:45 — 25 seconds before that event — with 63 qualifying in-radius fixes and a closest approach of about 22 m. The POL-NS-02 proximity test is met on admissible fixes, and the AIRPORT zone class comes from trip_record, not from assumption.
(c) The driver's single continuous in-geofence run ran 620 seconds, from 23:12:45 to 23:23:05, measured from the first qualifying fix as POL-NS-01(c) requires (not from the arrived tap). That is 140 seconds more than the 480-second minimum for AIRPORT.
(d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 23:23:20, after the minimum dwell elapsed at 23:20:45, on cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event anywhere in the record.

NO RIDER ROUTE DISPLACES THE FEE. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) does not fire: at the 23:13:10 marker the driver was already stationary inside the geofence, roughly 22 m from the pin — neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or above. POL-NS-06 (waiting-period shortfall) has nothing to bite on: there is no shortfall. POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered by driver) is closed at its own threshold — limb (a) requires at least one locating or coordinating message sent BY THE RIDER during the waiting window, and EV-CHAT-00202 holds only the SYSTEM arrival notice and two driver messages; there is no rider message and no in-app call in trip_record.in_app_calls. POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance) does not apply, because the driver's qualifying fixes fall inside the arrival radius rather than outside it but within 400 m.

THE RIDER'S REQUEST TO WAIVE THE CHARGE IS NOT SUPPORTED. The rider asks that the charge be excused because his flight was delayed and he did not see the messages until later. His account is consistent with the unread (read_at null) timestamps on the driver's messages, and I do not doubt he was delayed — but no clause makes the fee turn on that. POL-NS-06 fixes the fee against the driver's dwell 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages', and POL-NS-01 contains no rider-presence limb at all. The rider was right to say his whereabouts are not an element of the charge; that cuts against him here, because his absence from the pin does not defeat the fee either.

THE AMOUNT. The SGD 6.00 charged reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule — the GREATER of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) is SGD 6.00, exactly the fare_breakdown cancellation-fee line. There is no fare defect under POL-NS-08(d).

DRIVER COMPENSATION UNDER POL-NS-07. Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, the driver is compensated at 80 percent of SGD 6.00 = SGD 4.80. The anti-farming guard does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (the threshold is 4), and 1 of 168 completed trips in 30 days is far below the 0.08 rate. Neither limb is met, so compensation is paid. Per POL-GEN-03, a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling carries the same figure in amount_sgd and driver_compensation_sgd; the rider's own charge is unaffected and remains SGD 6.00.

PROFILE FIELDS. The rider's advocate is correct that prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed, prior_disputes_upheld, rating, lifetime_trips and acceptance_rate are context only under POL-GEN-01 and ground no finding either way; only the POL-NS-07 counters (no_show_terminations_30d, completed_trips_30d) are citable, and they clear the driver. The referee's flags on these mentions are warnings, not discards.

MISSING TRAFFIC ADVISORY. EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING and carries no weight (weight 0.0, POL-GEN-02). It is not needed for this outcome: the dwell is a single 620-second interval, so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is never invoked.

CONFIDENCE AND REFERRALS. The deciding facts rest on EV-GPS-00202, EV-TRIP-00202 and EV-FARE-00202; no impairment was disclosed against any of them, and the escalating conditions of POL-NS-09 do not arise — the driver arrival and dwell facts are uncontradicted, the anti-farming check is clear, and the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (the POL-NS-09(d) threshold is 3). No clause produces a referral on these facts, so the referrals list is empty.

ruling.explanation:

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: the SGD 6.00 no-show fee stands, and the driver is paid SGD 4.80 of it.

The fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 only if all four limbs hold, and each does. (a) The trip record (EV-TRIP-00202) carries a driver 'arrived' event at 23:13:10. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00202) places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius from the first qualifying fix at 23:12:45 — 25 seconds before the marker — with 63 qualifying in-radius fixes and a closest approach of about 22 m, so the POL-NS-02 proximity test is met on admissible fixes, and the zone class is taken from the trip record, not assumed. (c) The driver held position continuously for 620 seconds (23:12:45 to 23:23:05), 140 seconds more than the 480-second AIRPORT minimum, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as the clause requires and not from the arrived tap. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 23:23:20 on RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the minimum elapsed, with no boarding event.

No rider-exonerating clause applies. POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to bite on — the dwell exceeds the minimum. POL-NS-05 does not fire: at the marker the driver was stationary roughly 22 m from the pin, neither over 300 m away nor moving at 15 km/h or above. POL-NS-03 does not apply, because the driver was inside the arrival radius rather than outside it. POL-NS-04 fails at its limb (a): the chat log holds no rider message at all — a SYSTEM arrival notice at 23:13:11 and two driver messages at 23:14:02 and 23:19:30 — so the rider-contact route is closed before limb (c) is ever reached. The rider's account of a delayed flight and of being in the terminal is not a limb of the charge and does not displace the arithmetic: POL-NS-06 fixes the fee on the driver's dwell 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages', and POL-NS-01 contains no rider-presence limb. The rider's position (device stationary 2.0 to 2.2 km from the pin, zero qualifying fixes inside the 200 m presence radius) is therefore not used against the rider, and equally does not defeat the charge.

The fee reconciles with fee_schedule: the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) is SGD 6.00, exactly the fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee line, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. The trace and chat are unimpaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (c): 116 fixes at a 10 s cadence with no gaps (max gap 0 s, 100% coverage), no clock skew approaching 90 seconds, and three chat messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3. EV-ADVIS-00202-01 (traffic advisory) is MISSING and carries weight 0.0, but it carries no deciding fact — only a single in-geofence interval exists, so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is not in play, and nothing in this ruling rests on it, so it does not cap confidence.

POL-NS-07 then applies. With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee = SGD 4.80, the residual 20 percent retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming guard does not trip: driver no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1 of 168 completed trips in 30 days is far below the 0.08 rate, so neither limb is met and no escalation arises. Per POL-GEN-03, on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd; the filing party's own charge is unaffected. The rider's profile counters (prior_no_show_flags, rating, lifetime_trips, prior_disputes_filed, prior_disputes_upheld) and the driver's rating and acceptance_rate are context only under POL-GEN-01 and ground no finding against either party. No clause produces a referral on these facts.

This ruling concerns the SGD 6.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-00202 (Changi Airport Terminal 3, Door 5, 24 July 2026).

The fee stands. Under POL-NS-01 all four conditions for a chargeable no-show are met on the code-computed facts: (a) the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 23:13:10; (b) the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00202) places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius from 23:12:45, twenty-five seconds before that tap, with 63 qualifying in-radius fixes and a closest approach of about 22 m; (c) measured from that first qualifying in-geofence fix — and not from the arrived tap — the driver held position continuously for 620 seconds against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum, a surplus of 140 seconds; and (d) the trip was terminated by the driver at 23:23:20, after the minimum elapsed at 23:20:45, on cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event.

No clause displaces the fee. POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered) does not apply: the chat log (EV-CHAT-00202) holds no message from the rider, only the SYSTEM arrival notice and two driver messages (23:14:02 and 23:19:30); an unread inbound message is not a rider message. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) does not fire: at the marker the driver was already stationary roughly 22 m from the pin, neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or above. POL-NS-06 (waiting-period shortfall) has nothing to bite on — there was a surplus of time, not a shortfall. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply, because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it.

The rider's account that a delayed flight left him in the terminal and that he did not see the messages until later is noted, and the null read_at timestamps are consistent with it, but the charge does not depend on the rider's presence or response: POL-NS-06 fixes the fee against the driver's dwell 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. There is also no flight record in evidence. The rider track places the device 2.0–2.2 km from the pin throughout, which is why POL-NS-04(c) fails as well, but rider position is not an element of the charge.

The fare reconciles with the schedule: the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) is SGD 6.00, exactly the cancellation-fee line charged, so there is no fare defect under POL-NS-08(d).

The outcome for the driver is compensation under POL-NS-07: 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, i.e. SGD 4.80. The anti-farming guard does not trip (one no-show termination in the trailing 30 days, below the threshold of four, and 1 of 168 completed trips is far below the 0.08 rate). Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd carries the same figure, SGD 4.80; the rider's fee itself stands as presently charged.

The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is missing and carries weight 0.0 under POL-GEN-02(3); it supports no fact, makes POL-NS-06(i) unavailable, and is relied on by nothing in this ruling. The profile files are treated as context only under POL-GEN-01: the citable counters were checked, and no profile field grounds any finding against either party.
